description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Item' with multiple action methods for managing unassigned items, assigning items to purchase lists, converting items, and updating offsets within a project management context.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Item
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for handling item-related actions within the Coocook project.

methods.name: unassigned
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list unassigned dish ingredients, preparing data for display.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Handles POST requests to assign unassigned ingredients to purchase lists within a transaction.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Handles POST requests to convert a purchase list item to a different unit.

methods.name: update_offset
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the offset of a purchase list item, either by total or offset value.
